messages.subject: weighted intercept
parts:
I am using a latent growth model to determine the effect of Control Beliefs at time 1 on Conscientiousness, which was measured at two points in time. The code I was given uses both intercepts of Conscientiousness at T1 and T2, both weighted with factor 1, which I don´t really understand, to be honest. 

Since my research question deals with the effect of Control Beliefs on the change in Conscientiousness, is it a valid approach to set the weights for Conscientiousness at T2 to 0 and just correlating the Intercept of Control Beliefs with the slope of Conscientiousness? 

Does the model still work with Intercept2 set to 0?
